home.statLabel: An gina shi don ainihin sauyi
home.statDescription: A cikin tattalin arzikin da hauhawar farashi ta shekara ta wuce kashi 1,000, bayanan kudi suna rasa maana cikin makonni. Injin lissafin kudinmu yana sake bayyana kowace lamba ta atomatik kowane wata, ko da yaushe halin tattalin arzikinka yana da sifili nawa. Wannan dabara ce ta bakiliki da muke amfani da ita akan kowane yanki mai sauyi mai yawa, ba lamari daya kadai ba.
home.pillarsTitle: Ra'ayoyi guda uku akan gaskiya daya
home.pillar1Desc: Bincike na shaidar dijital tare da sarkar kiyayewa da za a iya tabbatarwa ta hanyar hash na kriftography. Kowace rikodi tana da alaka kuma ba za a iya canza ta ba tare da barin alama.
home.pillar2Desc: Jadawalin asusun da aka daidaita bisa ga sashe da yanki, rufe lokaci bisa ga IFRS, da injin kadai a kasuwa tare da daidaitawar hauhawar farashi na asali (IAS 29) don tattalin arzikin da ke da sauyi mai yawa.

home.differentiatorLabel: Me ya sa muke da bambanci
home.differentiatorTitle: Software na gama-gari yana bi da kowane yanki iri daya. Mu ba haka muke ba.
home.differentiatorDesc: Tsohuwar software na lissafin kudi tana bi da gidan burodi da kamfanin fitarwa iri daya kwatakwata: tsarin lissafin kudi iri daya, rahotanni iri daya. Muna gina kayan aiki na musamman don ainihin yanayinku - dokokin haraji, kudi, matakin hauhawar farashi - maimakon tilasta samfuri daya akan dukkan dandali.
home.securityTitle: Ba mu alkawarin tsaro kawai ba. Kuna iya tantance shi.
home.security1Desc: Kowace kamfani an kebe ta a matakin bayanan bayanai. Babu wani mai amfani da zai iya ganin bayanan wata kamfani, ko da ta hanyar kurakuran lambar.
home.security2Desc: Kowane rajistan lissafin kudi an hade shi ta hanyar rufaffiyar hanya. Kuna iya tantance cikakkiyar amincin littattafanku a kowane lokaci.
home.security3Desc: Kariya ta zabi ta kari don asusun gudanarwa, ba tare da wani cikas ga sauran kungiyar ba.
home.security4Title: Ayyuka da Izini Masu Cikakken Bayani
home.security4Desc: Ayyana daidai abin da kowane mai amfani zai iya gani da gyarawa, daga karantawa kawai zuwa cikakken mai gudanarwa.
home.plansDesc: Bincika tsare-tsaremu kuma nemo wanda ya dace da aikinku.
home.faq1Q: Idan yankina ba a rufe shi ba tukuna, zan iya amfani da dandali?
home.faq1A: Ee. Lissafin kudi na asali (IFRS, littattafan doka, rahotanni) yana aiki a kowane yanki. Kayan aiki na musamman, kamar daidaita hauhawar farashi mai tsanani, ana kunna su lokacin da yankinku ke bukatarsu.
home.faq2Q: Bayanan kudi na na amintacce ne?
home.faq2A: Kowace kamfani an kebe ta gaba daya a matakin bayanan bayanai, tare da sarkar blockchain mai tantancewa akan kowane rajistan lissafin kudi da tabbatarwa ta abubuwa biyu da ake samu.
home.faq3Q: Zan iya Ã†â„¢aura daga tsarin lissafin kudi na yanzu?
home.faq3A: Ee, muna tallafawa Ã†â„¢aurar tsarin lissafin kudi da ma'aunin farawa. Tuntube mu don kimanta yanayin ku na musamman.
home.faq4A: Ee, dukkan tsare-tsare sun hada da tallafi. Bayanai sun bambanta bisa ga tsari, duba sashen Ayyuka.

servicios.service2Desc: Cikakken lissafin kudi na IFRS, wanda aka daidaita don dokokin haraji na yankinka, tare da daidaitawar hauhawar farashi ta atomatik inda tattalin arzikinka ke bukata.
servicios.service3Desc: Bincike na jakunkuna da mu'amaloli, da rarraba hadarin kudi tare da shaida da za a iya tabbatarwa ta hanyar kriftography.

servicios.service5Desc: Atomatik na tabbatarwar doka da lura da bin doka akai-akai.
servicios.service6Desc: Yayin da muke karban masu amfani daga sabbin yankuna, muna gina kayan aikin haraji da doka wanda wannan yanayin musamman ke bukata.
servicios.plansHeadline: Tsari don kowane mataki na aikinku

servicios.planProDesc: Don kasuwanci a cikin tattalin arziki masu sauyi mai yawa ko yankuna da yawa.

tecnologia.headline: Fasaha
tecnologia.subheadline: Kayan aiki da aka gina akan ka'idojin tabbatarwa: kowace rikodin lissafin kudi tana da alaka ta hanyar kriftography, ana tabbatar da kowace sanarwa kafin a mika ta, kuma kowane yanki yana da dokokinsa masu aiki ba tare da tasiri ga wasu ba.
tecnologia.feature1Desc: Kowace rikodin jarida tana da alaka da wacce ta gabata ta hanyar hash na SHA-256. Canza rikodin tarihi yana karya sarkar ta hanyar da za a iya ganowa ta lissafi.
tecnologia.feature2Title: Injin Sake Bayyanawa don Hauhawar Farashi
tecnologia.feature2Desc: Daidaitawa ta atomatik na dukkanin bayanan kudi 4 (Ma'auni, Bayanin Ribar-Asara, Jarin Kamfani, Kudaden Shiga) bisa ga IAS 29, kowane wata, ta amfani da alamar farashin hukuma na kowace kasa.
tecnologia.feature3Desc: Samfuran nazari don gano tsari mai shakku da kimanta hasashe na hadarin kudi.
tecnologia.feature4Desc: Rabuwar bayanai a matakin kamfani a cikin database, tabbatarwa ta hanyoyi biyu na zabi, da matsayin shiga daki-daki ga kowane mai amfani.
tecnologia.feature5Desc: Nazarin farashin kashi tare da jerin rarrabuwa na hukuma da injin kudin aiki, don matakan kwangilar gwamnati.
tecnologia.feature6Desc: Dandali yana samuwa a cikin harsuna 17 a nahiyoyi 5, tare da sabbin fassarori da ake kirkirawa da tantancewa daidai da yadda ake kara sabbin fasaloli.

producto.headline: Duk abin da kuke bukata don gudanar da aikinku da gaskiya mai tantancewa
producto.subheadline: Yawon shakatawa na kayan aikin da za ku yi amfani da su kowace rana.
producto.section1Desc: Kallon hade-hade na aikinku: ma'aunin kudi, gargadin bin doka, da matsayin sassa 3 na ku a wuri daya.
producto.section2Title: Lissafin Kudi na Yau da Kullun
producto.section2Desc: Rikodin shigarwa, littattafan doka, da rahotannin kudi da ake samarwa ta atomatik daga aikinku.
producto.section3Desc: Bin diddigin shaidar dijital tare da sarkar kula mai tantancewa, ga masu duba lissafi da masu bincike.
producto.section4Desc: Nazarin farashin kashi da tsara tayin don matakan kwangilar gwamnati.

soluciones.headline: Dandali daya, wanda aka daidaita da aikinku
soluciones.subheadline: Gano yadda ayyuka daban-daban ke amfani da dandali kowace rana.
soluciones.role1Desc: Sarrafa cikakken lissafin kudi na doka na abokan cinikinku, tare da daidaita hauhawar farashi ta atomatik lokacin da tattalin arziki ke bukata.
soluciones.role2Desc: Bincika shaidar dijital tare da sarkar kula da ba za a iya canzawa ba tare da barin alama ta lissafi ba.
soluciones.role3Desc: Tsara tayin farashin kashi tare da jerin rarrabuwa na hukuma da injin kudin aiki.
soluciones.role4Title: Ga Kungiyoyi na Kasashe Da Yawa
soluciones.role4Desc: Sarrafa kamfanoni da yawa a yankuna daban-daban daga asusu daya, kowanne da dokokin harajinsa masu aiki.
